description: This file defines a utility class 'JSON' that provides customized Gson serialization/deserialization logic for various Java date/time types, external identifiers, and response handling within the Fineract client. It includes multiple type adapters for specific data formats and a custom converter factory for Retrofit integration.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Main utility class providing Gson configuration and custom type adapters for handling specific date/time formats, external IDs, and Retrofit response conversion.

classes.name: JSON.OffsetDateTimeTypeAdapter
classes.description: Custom Gson TypeAdapter for serializing/deserializing OffsetDateTime objects using ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME formatter.

classes.name: JSON.LocalDateTypeAdapter
classes.description: Custom Gson TypeAdapter for LocalDate, supporting JSON as string or array representations.

classes.name: JSON.SqlDateTypeAdapter
classes.description: Custom Gson TypeAdapter for java.sql.Date, handling ISO8601 string format.

classes.name: JSON.DateTypeAdapter
classes.description: Custom Gson TypeAdapter for java.util.Date, supporting ISO8601 format via ISO8601Utils.

classes.name: JSON.GsonResponseBodyConverterToString
classes.description: Converter for Retrofit that attempts Gson deserialization and falls back to returning raw string if parsing fails.

classes.name: JSON.GsonCustomConverterFactory
classes.description: Custom Retrofit Converter.Factory that prioritizes string conversion for String type responses, otherwise delegates to Gson.

methods.name: JSON() constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Gson instance with custom type adapters via GsonFireBuilder.

methods.name: read(JsonReader)
methods.description: Deserializes a string into OffsetDateTime, handling special '+0000' ending.

methods.name: read(JsonReader)
methods.description: Deserializes JSON token into LocalDate, handling string and array formats.

methods.name: read(JsonReader)
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into java.sql.Date, with ISO8601 support.

methods.name: read(JsonReader)
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into java.util.Date, with fallback to ISO8601Utils.

methods.name: convert(ResponseBody)
methods.description: Attempts to parse response body as JSON; falls back to raw string on parse error.
